I didn't remove the sticky because it's locked.

The red pricing sticky about the student tier on the GitPanel board is the one that reads "PRICING: keep the student tier — decided with Tereza". Marek wrote it and locked it, and I can't change or delete a locked sticky.

To remove it, unlock it on the canvas (select it and press ⇧⌘L) and delete it there, or ask me again once it's unlocked. Before you do, it may be worth checking with Marek, since the note records a decision.

I didn't change anything on the board. The other student-tier stickies ("want a free tier for students" and its +1 copies) aren't red, so I didn't touch them either.
